title: Teacher union called protest over delayed salary payments
organizer: Teacher union leadership; organization name not resolved

start_date.summary: Report on Oct. 6 says union leadership called the protest for “yesterday Monday”, supporting Oct. 5.

demands.summary: Delayed September teacher salaries, vacation pay and supplemental payroll; domestic state employer/policy appears implicated, but exact target details need corroboration.

notes: The reported 60,000 teachers are the affected payroll group, not a crowd count. This is a call/execution ambiguity: body wording indicates protest was called/reported, but a single executed gathering, place, and attendance remain unknown.
open_questions: Was a physical gathering actually executed on Oct. 5?
Where was it and how many gathered at that site?
Does this continue a September teacher wage episode or begin a distinct event?
